Services and vet-hospital economics: the number that matters is comparable sales split between consumables, supplies and services. Vet clinic build-out pace is disclosed in the 10-Q and is where the operating leverage sits

Ownership: CVC and Canada Pension Plan hold the Class B structure - check 13D/G amendments and any registration statements for a secondary or a take-private
